title: What Makes a Good Individual House Builder in Chennai

seo.metaTitle: Individual House Builder Checklist for Chennai | Hunter Property
seo.metaDescription: Building one house, not a flat? See what separates a good individual-house builder from a developer: workload, site supervision, BOQs and payment terms.

excerpt: An apartment developer and an individual house builder run different businesses. This checklist covers what to look for when you are building just one house, and how to manage the small-builder trade-off.
faqTitle: Choosing an individual house builder: common questions

faqs.question: How many projects should a builder be running at once?
faqs.answer: Ask for the number. If each site engineer is looking after more than a handful of houses, supervision on yours will be thin.

faqs.question: Why ask to see the builder’s last individual house?
faqs.answer: Because apartment work does not prove a firm can deliver a one-off brief. Their last individual house, not their last project, shows how they handle a batch of one.

faqs.question: Should a builder price my specification or only their package?
faqs.answer: Both. A package is a useful starting point, but a good builder should also price your own specification line by line. Our packages are priced per sq ft of built-up area: Basic ₹2,199, Standard ₹2,399, Premium ₹2,699 and Ultra Luxury ₹3,199. Approvals, soil test, compound wall, sump and interiors are quoted separately. Changes are priced in the BOQ.

faqs.question: What payment terms protect me with a smaller builder?
faqs.answer: Stage-linked payments tied to completed work, a retention of five to ten percent until snags are closed, and a written specification so nothing depends on memory. These protect both sides, and any builder worth hiring agrees to them.

faqs.question: Who should I expect to see on site?
faqs.answer: Get a number of visits, not a promise of “regular supervision”. With us, the person who quotes you is the person on site.
